articles.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
articles.description: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3  billion round led by Bessemer.

articles.title: Reddit tests ads in search results as traffic declines and growth concerns mount
articles.description: The new ad placements could help Reddit squeeze more revenue from existing users as Google's AI search changes how people discover its content.

articles.title: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
articles.description: The Luce, Ferrari's first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, is "fully allocated" through 2027, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna.

articles.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
articles.description: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

articles.title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
articles.description: CrowdStrike said it will buy Fiddler AI, which makes AI agent observability software, and Dreadnode, which helps companies automate AI security testing.

articles.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
articles.description: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

articles.title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.description: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
articles.description: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

articles.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
articles.description: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

articles.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
articles.description: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

articles.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
articles.description: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.description: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: New York City’s Mamdani criticizes Madison Square Garden owner over surveillance tech
articles.description: The mayor's comments come after the entertainment giant's data breach last year, which exposed James Dolan's surveillance.

articles.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
articles.description: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
articles.description: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

articles.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
articles.description: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”

articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.description: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: South Korea asks its biggest banks how a major crypto hack would hit them
articles.description: In its first such survey, the BOK also asked about a crypto price crash, losses at another firm, and each firm’s crypto teams, budgets and investments.

articles.title: The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on Nov. 4
articles.description: On Nov. 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 brings founders and VCs to Boston's SoWa Power Station for practical insights and connections. Register before prices increase at the door.

articles.title: CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance’s historic $6.3 billion heist
articles.description: While investigators found no evidence that AI agents laundered the stolen Binance funds, Zhao stressed that automated tools are lowering the barrier for complex breaches.
